notes_for_editor: Thin record: brief one-line entries only. Kamstra's 1940 may or may not be the build year. The O'Neil description names Canyon among neighbouring stations, some unmanned, but does not say Canyon was unmanned. No remains or access description found. The NRHP Hornet Lookout form cites Flathead NF improvement plan records, which may hold Canyon's construction details; not searched.
